summary: Feed s096_single is degraded: 82.5% of bytes are encrypted, exceeding the IDS tolerance of 60%. Payload inspection is blinded, reducing detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: 83% of bytes are TLS-encrypted (vs 60% IDS tolerance) with no decryption stage before the IDS, so payloads remain opaque to inspection.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature/anomaly detection; encrypted traffic bypasses inspection, causing missed intrusions and severely reduced detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Adding SSL visibility/decryption (or selective TLS offload) before the IDS will restore cleartext payload and bring encrypted share below the 60% threshold the IDS can tolerate.
